meta.undistorted_coordinate_convention: undistorted_xy_px uses cv2.undistortPoints(K,D,P=K); normalized_xy uses P=None. Separate calibration.json supplies numeric K/R/t/F.

gate_policies.unknown: Raw/effective API unknown stays unchanged. An explicit optional viewer policy may show best_named from the original 22-class vector, without renormalization; all-zero named evidence remains no_named_evidence.
gate_policies.best_named_ties: Use the actual highest original canonical-class probability; exact ties follow meta.marker_names order. Preserve all tied_best_names.
gate_policies.best_named_confidence: best_named.confidence is the confidence returned for the original API choice, not calibrated confidence of the derived candidate.
gate_policies.comparison: Selected p >= slider; model confidence >= slider; detector confidence >= slider; selected p margin >= 0.
gate_policies.duplicate_id: Per camera/frame/name, choose highest selected p, then highest model confidence, then lowest current DINO point index.
gate_policies.epipolar_noise: After duplicate selection, exclude the winning point only when its flag is set and its current displayed marker equals epipolar_noise_marker. Do not promote an untested duplicate.
gate_policies.detector_cache_limit: The cache contains only detections already passing 0.425; a slider cannot create uncomputed lower-score points.
gate_policies.review_probability_domain: Nine effective answers use marker-to-point choice probability, while raw answers use point-to-marker choice probability.
gate_policies.top3: Actual descending probabilities, alphabetical tie-break; displayed top3 values rounded to six decimals. unknown_p remains separately available.
